newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - New York City RANs.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - New York City RANs.

text.p: To Be Dated Date of Delivery on or about October 9, 1996

To Be Dated Date of Delivery on or about October 9, 1996 SEALEDPROPOSALS will be received for all or part of the Notes in integral multiples of $25,000,000, on at 11:00 A.M. by the Comptroller of the City at his office in Room 530, 5th Floor, Municipal Building, One Centre Street, New York, NY 10007; provided, however, that notice of a change in such time or date, or in other matters relating to the Notes, may be given not later than 1:00 P.M. on the day prior to the time originally scheduled for the receipt of such proposals by a supplemental notice. The City will specify the Coupon on the Notes in such a supplemental notice.

Principal of and interest on the $1,050,000,000 Fiscal 1997 Series B Notes, due June 30, 1997 will be secured by Letters of Credit to be provided, on a several basis, by three banks:Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, New York Agency, ($435 Million Plus Interest), The Bank of Nova Scotia, New York Agency, ($350 Million Plus Interest), and Commerzbank AG, New York Branch, ($265 Million Plus
Interest). Each Bank's letter of credit will be provided for the benefit of all the Noteholders for such Bank's
proportionate share of the total amount of principal and interest on the Notes.

Bidders may obtain, on Friday, September 27, 1996, the Preliminary Official Statement to be dated September 26, 1996, which will contain the Official Bid Form and Notice of Sale, by faxing a request to the Customer Service
